snippet.title: Save the Flame Trailer
snippet.description:
MassDiGI SIP19 trailer for Save the Flame game.

Explore the world of Vishal as you play Omar, a young fire magic prodigy and last hope for humanity.  In this endless runner, Omar is trying to take back The Flame from the ancient spirit Onii, while dodging possessed obstacle fragments, and collecting coins to help with his quest.  Will you be able to save the flame, or will Onii plunge humanity into darkness forever? Coming soon.

2019
